title: antirrhinum repens var. monspessulanum
intro: Antirrhinum repens var. monspessulanum, commonly known as the downy toadflax, is a plant species within the snapdragon family (Scrophulariaceae). This plant is used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Antirrhinum repens var. monspessulanum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and expectorant, which helps relieve respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of reducing inflammation, fighting oxidative stress, and modulating immune responses.
